reason: A DSH web search provider plugin that uses Tavily to return search results with generated summaries and structured citations.

summaries.zh: 通过 Tavily API 为 DSH 的 web_search 提供包含摘要和结构化引用来源的网页搜索结果。
summaries.en: Adds a Tavily-backed web search provider to DSH that returns search results with summaries and structured citation sources.

capabilities: Performs web searches through the Tavily API
Reads a Tavily API key from configured credentials or environment variables
Registers Tavily as the DSH web search provider
Returns search summaries and structured citation metadata
